component.name: jterm2
component.summary: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator built with Rust and egui

description.p: jterm2 renders its terminal grid on the GPU through egui and wgpu, with a glow fallback for machines whose drivers prefer OpenGL.

ul.li: Tabs and split panes over a shared PTY session model
Configurable themes, fonts, and UI scale, with CJK fallback fonts
A companion jsh shell that the palette can install or update
